description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of Git's upload-pack ref-in-want functionality, involving setup of repositories, executing fetch operations, and validating responses under various configurations and scenarios.

methods.name: get_actual_refs
methods.description: Extracts and unpacks reference lines from the output file.

methods.name: get_actual_commits
methods.description: Processes the output to extract commit hashes and sorts them for comparison.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Runs the fetch steps and compares the actual output with expected data.

methods.name: write_command
methods.description: Constructs and outputs a command with optional object format details.

methods.name: write_fetch_command
methods.description: Generates a complete fetch command sequence based on input read from stdin.

methods.name: inconsistency
methods.description: Simulates a server state change during negotiation to test resilience.
